lines.text: there with us and her and um pointing out those areas that we wanted ya to point out. Is that all right? (Brendan nods “yes”) OK.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Do you know where those shoes are that you were wearing that day? The red shoes?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) I think they're in the closet.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. All right. We'll have your mom come in for a few minutes, OK? All right.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: Why didn't you tell me? Huh?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Barbara give me your coffee, it's in your hands right now.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: Huh? Did he make you do it? (Brendan nods “yes”) I woulda walked out. That's what I woulda did. (crying during pause) Why didn't you just tell 'em, no? Huh?

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: You knew it was wrong, right? (Brendan nods “yes”) (pause) Do you know you can't come home? Do you know where you're going? (pause)

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: I don't know. I do not know. (pause) Do I have ta get some him an attorney, or will they do it for me?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: The court will assign one for him or the state will pay for his attorney if he can't pay for it, but obviously you have a right at any time to try and get him one or get him one.
